name: winforge
description: WinForge — scaffold, develop, build and package Windows desktop apps (Electron & Tauri) from macOS and Linux

scripts.create:example: npm run create:example:electron && npm run create:example:tauri && npm run create:example:ci
scripts.create:example:tauri: node packages/cli/dist/index.js create examples/tauri-hello --template tauri --ui react --pm npm --app-name "Hello Tauri" --package-id com.winforge.examples.taurihello --app-version 0.1.0 --author "WinForge" --description "Example Tauri app generated by WinForge." --non-interactive --force --no-install
scripts.create:example:electron: node packages/cli/dist/index.js create examples/electron-hello --template electron --ui react --pm npm --app-name "Hello WinForge" --package-id com.winforge.examples.hello --app-version 0.1.0 --author "WinForge" --description "Example Electron app generated by WinForge." --non-interactive --force --no-install
scripts.create:example:ci: npm run create:example:ci:electron && npm run create:example:ci:tauri
